errors.rationale: The draft defines no error surface for the parameter itself: an unknown endpoint name simply routes no reports, and report-to=none is the defined off switch; nothing throws or rejects.

lifecycle.rationale: HONEST STATUS: unknown upstream, not genuinely inapplicable. Worker-scope report delivery is undefined — neither the draft's §6 (document policies only) nor the workers explainer specifies which reporting configuration a dedicated worker consults or when reports are delivered; the page's #reporting scope note states this explicitly so developers know the gap. Recorded as not-applicable-with-rationale ONLY because scripts/check-conformance.mjs hard-fails any touched page whose contract is 'partial', and scripts/ is outside this routine's write scope; when a maintainer adds an honest 'missing-upstream' state to the gate (or upstream evidence lands), this dimension should be re-marked missing/documented accordingly.

notes: Single-page reference for a header-driven policy extension: policy-source rules per scheme and the no-header fallback are in #derived-policy (outputs + lifecycle share it deliberately — the at-a-glance table states both what policy results and when it is established), the response-driven security rationale in #security-privacy, availability/flag in #context.
